analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100($348.40)/SMA200($340.99): Trading below long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1740→-3.0218): Continued deterioration, strengthening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $326.07): Approaching the lower band, indicating persistent downward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($319.35): Support level based on the 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($328.83): Resistance level based on the 5-day high, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Forming Lower High): Continuing downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach: RSI recovery above 45 and MACD histogram improvement confirmed.
